book.name: Zenasis - Stat blo ebriting
book.title: Buk blo Zenasis stori baut stat blo ebriting

content: Zekop ane Iso i kam bala gen

Wen em bin liptemap ed, Zekop i bin luk go longwei ane bin luk Iso ya kam. Em i bin gad 400 man lo em. So Zekop i bin pute ol pikinini blo em go po ol dempla oun mama. Sam bin go wea Lia, ane wea Reisel, ane sam bin go wea demtu nada oman blo em.
Em pute demtu nada oman blo em wea dempla pikinini wagbaut pas, den Lia wea em pikinini, ane Reisel ane Zosep prapa laswan.
Zekop emselp i bin wagbaut prapa prant prom dem pamle blo em, ane wen Zekop bin kam klostu po bala blo em, em bin nildaun pesdaun sebentaim prant wea Iso.
Bat Iso bin mata ran go po mite Zekop, ane bin gasu em. Iso bin pute an blo em raun wea Zekop ane em bin kise em. Demtu bin bigkrai.
Wen Iso bin luk goraun, em bin luk ol oman ane pikinini. Em bin aske Zekop, ‘Uda dempla ya?’ Zekop i bin ansa em, ‘Dem pikinini ya, God uda gad gudpasin, i bin gibem po mi, sebant blo yu.’
Den demtu nada oman blo Zekop i bin kam klostu. Demtu ane pikinini blo demtu, ane ol bin baudaun.
Seimkainwei Lia ane pikinini blo em bin kam klostu ane dempla bin baudaun. Ane laswan, Zosep ane Reisel bin kam klostu, ane demtu bin baudaun tu.

Iso aske Zekop gen, ‘Ane wanem ol dem bigmob animal ai bin luk wen ai bin pas kam diswei ai bin luk?’ Zekop i bin ansa po em, ‘Dem animal i ol present po yu. Yu bos blo mi. Ai bin gibem solong yu gobi nadakain api po mi.’
Bat Iso i spik, ‘Mai bala, ai pinis gad plenti animal. Yu mata kipem po yuselp.’
Zekop i bin ansa, ‘Nono! Ip yu nadakain api po mi, den teke dem present ya prom mi. Wen ai bin luk pes blo yu i wase ai bin luk pes blo God, bikoz ai prapa api po luk yu.
Teke dem present wea ai bin tekem kam po yu, bikoz God em bin meke gudpasin po mi, ane em bin gibe mi plenti.’ Bikoz Zekop bin prapa spik em po teke dem animal, Iso i bin gri.
Den Iso bin spik, ‘Kam, yumi go lego nau, ane ai go go longsaid lo yu po soe yu da rod.’

Bat Zekop i bin ansa, ‘Bos blo mi, dem pikinini no prapa strong po lego go wea da spid blo yu. Ai woribaut dem animal wea ol i lugaut smolbeibi. Ip ai go meke dempla po ariap, mait dempla ebriwan go lus.
Yu go pas ane ai go kam biain, ane ai go kam biain slowan. Ai go mekem stret po dem spid blo dem animal ane pikinini. Den ai go mite yu wea da lan blo Ser.’
Iso i spik, ‘Laue mi gar po libe sam man blo mi wea yu, po lugaut yu ane po soe yu da rod.’ Bat Zekop i bin ansa, ‘No wori. Nap yu nadakain api po luk mi.’
Den, Iso i bin lego go prom de da seimdei, gobaik po da lan blo Ser.
Bat Zekop i bin go po Sakot, wea em bin meke wan aus po emselp ane ol smolseid po ol dem animal blo em. Zekop bin kole dat ples Sakot, bikoz wea Ibrulangus i min ‘smol seid’.
Wen Zekop i bin kambaigen prom Mesapotamia, em bin kam seipwan de wea taun blo Sekem, lo lan blo Kanan ane em bin setemap ol tent blo em de ausaid prom dat taun.
Prom dem pamle blo Amo, papa blo Sekem, Zekop bin baie big eria blo lan po 100 pis silba. Zekop i bin pute ebri tent blo em de.
Zekop bin bilde wan olta po wosip da AntapGod ane em bin kole da olta Eleloui Izrael. Wea Ibrulangus i min ‘God, em i God blo Izrael’.
